employeeInputs.source: DR 0004 Line 2 or W-4 filing-status default

steps: annualReduction = DR 0004 Line 2, including zero, when supplied; otherwise 11000 for married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse and 5500 for all other W-4 filing statuses
certificatePrecedence: A submitted DR 0004 controls Lines 2 and 3, including an explicit zero.
Without DR 0004, use the W-4 filing-status default.
A W-4 claiming exemption produces zero withholding unless the Department adjusts the claim.
Without either certificate, use the single-status 5500 annual reduction.
calculation.certificateReplacementRule: A new W-4 without a new DR 0004 revokes the prior DR 0004 and any pre-2022 additional-withholding request.
calculation.separateSupplementalMethodStatus: No distinct supplemental-wage method was located in the captured 2026 worksheet.

residencyAndWorkRules.residentRule: Withhold from federally taxable Colorado wages paid to a Colorado resident whether the work is performed inside or outside Colorado.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentRule: Withhold from federally taxable wages paid to a nonresident for services physically performed in Colorado.

filing.frequencySelectionBasis: Total annual Colorado wage withholding liability
